text.p: TCI Satellite Entertainment (TSAT) said Primestar's GE-S satellite was successfully launched on Thursday aboard an Ariane 44L rocket from French Guiana.
The launch will allow the service to increase its channel capacity by 65 channels, increasing Primestar's total offering to 160.
TSAT holds a 20.86 percent interest in Primestar and serves more than 700,000 customers through Primestar by TCI, which expects to begin providing new services to customers later this spring.
The full new lineup will be announced on Feb 27, but includes The History Channel, C-SPAN 2, Court TV, Viacom Inc's VH1 and Home & Garden Television, TSAT said.
TSAT was formerly part of Tele-Communications Inc, but became a public company in December.
